chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'a and Salih ibn Khalid from Abu Jamilya from Zayd from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the brothers from the mother alongside the grandfather
He said: 'For the brothers from the mother, their prescribed share is one-third alongside the grandfather.'

key_terms.اَلْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ اَلْأُمِّ: Maternal siblings (sharing the same mother but different fathers)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal siblings when the paternal grandfather is present?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific ruling for maternal siblings inheriting alongside the paternal grandfather, a key scenario in Shia inheritance jurisprudence (*'Ilm al-Fara'id*). It establishes that their share is strictly one-third, distinguishing this fixed portion from cases where they might receive the residual balance (*residuary*). This ruling is significant for resolving potential conflicts between the grandfather's share and that of the maternal siblings in complex family structures.
